title: Output-path cleanup rewrites literal user-specified names
reasoning: The cleanup applies unconditional string replacements across the entire resolved template, even when agent.version is present or the template contains no version interpolation. Legitimate literal directory names containing '-None', 'None_', double underscores, or trailing underscores are changed. Distinct requested output paths can therefore collapse to the same destination, and runs are routed to names the user did not specify.
reproduction: Load with cli_overrides=['save_template=trial__A_']. The returned save_template is 'trial_A', although the template contains no interpolation or missing version.
recommendation: Restrict missing-version cleanup to the version interpolation and its associated separators; preserve literal template text and unrelated interpolated values.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing test requires cleanup for a missing version in the default template. Custom-template tests use simple paths without characters affected by the cleanup and do not verify literal preservation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend custom-template coverage to assert exact preservation of literal path components and distinct destinations, both with and without an agent version, while retaining the default-template missing-version scenario.
minimumFixScope: _resolve_save_template in loader.py and output-template scenarios in test_loader.py.
